lines.zh: 我挪不动，只能随风轻晃
lines.en: I cannot move; I only sway with the wind.

lines.zh: 我的壳挂在叶片背面，很稳
lines.en: My shell hangs under the leaf, secure.

lines.zh: 你要帮我搬，得连叶子一起掰
lines.en: To move me, you would have to break the leaf too.

lines.zh: 我的身体在壳里慢慢转了个方向
lines.en: Inside the shell, my body slowly turns.

lines.zh: 一动就会掉下去，所以我不动
lines.en: Move and I would fall, so I do not.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我跟着荡一下
lines.en: A gust comes, and I swing once.

lines.zh: 这片叶子的柄撑得住我
lines.en: This leaf stem holds me.

lines.zh: 雨滴砸在壳上，我晃了晃
lines.en: Rain strikes the shell and I rock.

lines.zh: 我在原地，等翅长成
lines.en: I stay put until the wings are grown.

lines.zh: 壳里的东西在整理自己
lines.en: Something inside is arranging itself.

lines.zh: 我抓住叶脉，抓得很紧
lines.en: I grip the leaf vein, tightly.

lines.zh: 我不需要走，我有这片叶
lines.en: I need not walk; I have this leaf.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，我贴得更近
lines.en: In strong wind I press closer.

lines.zh: 我换不了位置，只能等
lines.en: I cannot change places; I can only wait.

lines.zh: 我的外壳硬了，里面在动
lines.en: My shell has hardened; inside, something stirs.

lines.zh: 丛林的湿气让我很舒服
lines.en: The jungle damp suits me.

lines.zh: 我安静地吊着，像一枚果实
lines.en: I hang quietly, like a fruit.

lines.zh: 我的壳是半透明的青色
lines.en: My shell is translucent green.

lines.zh: 里面能看到翅膀的轮廓
lines.en: The outline of wings shows through.

lines.zh: 我靠壳里存下的那点水
lines.en: I live on the little water stored in my shell.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶隙，照在我背上
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaves onto my back.

lines.zh: 我在数还要多久
lines.en: I am counting how much longer.

lines.zh: 这片丛林里的声音我都听得见
lines.en: I hear all the sounds of this jungle.

lines.zh: 我的表面在慢慢变硬
lines.en: My surface slowly hardens.

lines.zh: 我不动，鸟就看不见我
lines.en: Still as I am, birds do not see me.

lines.zh: 壳里的翅在微微抖
lines.en: The wings inside tremble faintly.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，雨淋不到
lines.en: Under the leaf, the rain cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我这一层壳快撑不住了
lines.en: This shell of mine is near its limit.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖到我身上了
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen over me.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能被你看着
lines.en: I cannot move; all I can do is be looked at.

lines.zh: 你伸手碰了碰我的壳
lines.en: You reached out and touched my shell.

lines.zh: 别捏太紧，里面有活的东西
lines.en: Do not squeeze; something living is inside.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，记下了
lines.en: I know your scent now, and remember it.

lines.zh: 我不会跑，也跑不了
lines.en: I cannot flee, and cannot run.

lines.zh: 你的脸凑得很近
lines.en: Your face is very close.

lines.zh: 我在壳里听得见你呼吸
lines.en: Inside the shell I can hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 这片叶子是我的，你别摘
lines.en: This leaf is mine; do not pick it.

lines.zh: 等我出来，你会看见蓝的
lines.en: When I come out, you will see blue.

lines.zh: 我被碰掉了一点，晃得厉害
lines.en: A bit knocked off; I swing hard.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了一道细缝
lines.en: A thin crack opens in the shell.

lines.zh: 里面动了一下，很急
lines.en: Something inside moves, urgently.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫不出来
lines.en: I cannot cry out; I have no voice.

lines.zh: 液体从缝里渗出来
lines.en: Liquid seeps from the crack.

lines.zh: 我抓紧叶脉，抓得更紧
lines.en: I grip the vein tighter.

lines.zh: 这一下可能让我出不来
lines.en: That might keep me from getting out.

lines.zh: 我的外壳变得更暗了
lines.en: My shell has darkened.

lines.zh: 我在壳里蜷成一团
lines.en: I curl into a ball inside.

lines.zh: 这道缝够我受很久
lines.en: This crack will cost me a long time.

lines.zh: 我不吃不喝，你不用给我
lines.en: I do not eat or drink; no need to offer.

lines.zh: 树叶就是我的全部
lines.en: The leaf is all I need.

lines.zh: 你把东西凑过来，我没有反应
lines.en: You hold it near; I do not react.

lines.zh: 这点甜蜜，我用不上
lines.en: That sweetness is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 我只想安安静静待到羽化
lines.en: I only want quiet until I emerge.

lines.zh: 你晃得太厉害，我抓紧了叶脉
lines.en: You shake too much; I grip the vein.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就掉下去了
lines.en: Any closer and I will fall.

lines.zh: 我不需要被喂
lines.en: I do not need feeding.

lines.zh: 你手心的热气透进壳里
lines.en: The heat of your palm seeps into the shell.

lines.zh: 放着吧，等来的不是我
lines.en: Leave it; it is not I who will come.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下，我整个晃了
lines.en: One touch from you and I swing.

lines.zh: 我撞到叶面，又贴回去
lines.en: I bump the leaf and settle back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我差点脱开叶脉
lines.en: That nearly tore me from the vein.

lines.zh: 我没有反抗的力气
lines.en: I have no strength to resist.

lines.zh: 壳被撞出一声轻响
lines.en: The shell gives a small knock.

lines.zh: 你退开，我慢慢停了
lines.en: You step back, and I slowly still.

lines.zh: 里面的翅缩了一下
lines.en: The wings inside pull in.

lines.zh: 树叶被我扯得发响
lines.en: The leaf rustles as I pull at it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，只有一点点声音
lines.en: We touched, and there was only a small sound.

lines.zh: 别再碰了，我经不起
lines.en: Do not touch again; I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我还不是能飞的形状
lines.en: I am not yet the shape that flies.

lines.zh: 要等我出来，才谈得上这个
lines.en: Wait until I emerge; then it could be.

lines.zh: 我在这里，只为了变成另一种东西
lines.en: I am here only to become something else.

lines.zh: 等翅干了，我会去找同色的一只
lines.en: Once the wings dry, I will seek one of my color.

lines.zh: 我这一层壳里没有性别，只有等待
lines.en: In this shell there is no sex, only waiting.

lines.zh: 将来会有人在叶上相遇
lines.en: Someday two will meet on a leaf.

lines.zh: 你我都挂在树上，但不一样
lines.en: We both hang on trees, but not the same.

lines.zh: 我把这件事留给羽化后的自己
lines.en: I leave that to the self after emergence.

lines.zh: 我静得不像是活的
lines.en: I am so still I hardly seem alive.

lines.zh: 时间会做完剩下的事
lines.en: Time will finish the rest.

lines.zh: 我拿不了东西，我的手在壳里
lines.en: I cannot hold anything; my hands are in the shell.

lines.zh: 你要拿走我，就连叶子一起
lines.en: To take me, take the leaf with me.

lines.zh: 我被拎起来，晃得厉害
lines.en: Lifted, I swing wildly.

lines.zh: 别把我放在地上，我会死
lines.en: Do not put me on the ground; I would die.

lines.zh: 你把我按在别的叶上，我贴住了
lines.en: You press me to another leaf, and I cling.

lines.zh: 我的壳在指间发出细响
lines.en: My shell whispers between your fingers.

lines.zh: 你放得有点斜，我歪着
lines.en: You set me crooked, and I hang askew.

lines.zh: 这一移，我得多等几天
lines.en: This move costs me a few more days.

lines.zh: 我抓紧了新的叶脉
lines.en: I grip the new leaf vein.

lines.zh: 谢谢你没有捏碎我
lines.en: Thank you for not crushing me.

lines.zh: 我动不了，谈不上锁定
lines.en: I cannot move, so there is nothing to lock.

lines.zh: 我只能判断谁离我最近
lines.en: I can only tell who is closest.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我一直跟着
lines.en: I follow the warmth of you.

lines.zh: 我在壳里也能听见脚步
lines.en: Even in the shell I hear footsteps.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子是我的全部世界
lines.en: This leaf is my whole world.

lines.zh: 我把需要的东西都收在壳里
lines.en: Everything I need is sealed in the shell.

lines.zh: 我不需要攻击谁
lines.en: I need to attack no one.

lines.zh: 如果鸟来了，我只能赌它看不见
lines.en: If a bird comes, I can only hope it misses me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的东西
lines.en: I wait for something that will not come.

lines.zh: 我把自己收得更紧
lines.en: I draw myself in tighter.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的方向，很久了
lines.en: I have faced your direction a long time.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，壳里的我就绷紧
lines.en: Your hand moves; inside my shell I tense.

lines.zh: 壳里越来越挤了
lines.en: It grows crowded in here.

lines.zh: 翅在壳里叠着，还不能动
lines.en: The wings are folded and cannot move yet.

lines.zh: 外面那点风，是我唯一的线索
lines.en: That bit of wind is my only clue.

lines.zh: 我数着雨点落在壳上的次数
lines.en: I count the raindrops on the shell.

lines.zh: 你还在那儿，我知道
lines.en: You are still there; I know.

lines.zh: 再有一会儿，我就不在这个形状里了
lines.en: In a little while I will not be in this shape.

lines.zh: 我感觉到光在移动
lines.en: I feel the light moving.

lines.zh: 我安静地等你走开
lines.en: I wait quietly for you to go.

lines.zh: 我没有任何攻击的办法
lines.en: I have no way to attack.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我只能晃
lines.en: Touch me and all I can do is swing.

lines.zh: 壳是我唯一的防护
lines.en: The shell is my only defense.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅还软着
lines.en: The wings inside are still soft.

lines.zh: 我只能缩起来，等这一下过去
lines.en: I can only curl and let it pass.

lines.zh: 我只有一层薄壳挡着
lines.en: I have only a thin shell for cover.

lines.zh: 被捏一下，我就完了
lines.en: One squeeze and I am finished.

lines.zh: 叶片是我躲的地方
lines.en: The leaf is where I hide.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩到壳的一侧
lines.en: I pull to one side of the shell.

lines.zh: 再过些日子，我就能飞了
lines.en: In a few days I could fly.

lines.zh: 毛虫在这片叶上把我结了出来
lines.en: A caterpillar spun me on this leaf.

lines.zh: 丛林的湿气里，我慢慢变硬
lines.en: In the jungle damp, I slowly harden.

lines.zh: 我一开始只是一团丝
lines.en: At first I was only a bundle of silk.

lines.zh: 这片叶子的背面被选中了
lines.en: The underside of this leaf was chosen.

lines.zh: 我挂在这里，没有人注意到
lines.en: I hang here and no one notices.

lines.zh: 我不需要被打扰
lines.en: I do not need to be disturbed.

lines.zh: 是丛林的温度让我成了形
lines.en: The jungle's warmth shaped me.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和叶背差不多
lines.en: My color nearly matches the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 没有谁搬动我，我自己挂上去的
lines.en: No one placed me; I hung myself here.

lines.zh: 我等着翅变硬的那一天
lines.en: I wait for the day the wings harden.

lines.zh: 热透过壳，我里面都在缩
lines.en: Heat passes through the shell; everything inside contracts.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，撞在草上
lines.en: I fall from the leaf and hit the grass.

lines.zh: 水渗进壳缝，我闷得发慌
lines.en: Water seeps in through the crack; I panic.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶上扯下来
lines.en: The blast tears me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我，很细
lines.en: Something pierces me, very thin.

lines.zh: 一股暖流过壳，我抖了一下
lines.en: A warm current crosses the shell; I shudder.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这一点没关系
lines.en: I do not eat, so that matters not.

lines.zh: 雷光透进来，整个壳都亮了
lines.en: Lightning light floods in; the whole shell glows.

lines.zh: 叶子没有了，我在往下掉
lines.en: The leaf is gone; I am falling.
